messages.subject: nominal model
parts:
Thissen, Cai, & Bock (2010, pp. 58-65) discuss a new parameterization of
the nominal response model. Google books has a preview of some of the
relevant pages. Can mirt estimate nominal models with arbitrary T
matrices for the scoring function and intercept parameters? How is this
accomplished? Are there examples?

http://www.amazon.com/Handbook-Polytomous-Response-Theory-Models/dp/0805859926

--
Joshua N. Pritikin
Department of Psychology
University of Virginia
485 McCormick Rd, Gilmer Hall Room 102
Charlottesville, VA 22904
http://people.virginia.edu/~jnp3bc

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: nominal model
parts: It does not follow this particular implementation, mainly because I did not become aware of the parameterization until a good chunk of the package was already written. The nominal, gpcm (and pcm), and 2PL are therefore all separate implementations and classes rather than estimated with particular T matrices; which isn't a problem, it's just not as elegant as defining a T matrix for each special case of the nominal model.
